Disclaimer: This information is for educational and informational purposes only and is not a substitute for professional medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment. Never use this information to self-diagnose or self-treat. Always seek the advice of your physician or other qualified health provider with any questions you may have regarding a medical condition. The medicines listed are examples and must only be taken under a doctor's prescription and supervision.

diseases.name: Common Cold
diseases.description: A viral infection of the upper respiratory tract (nose and throat).
medicines: No specific antiviral. Symptom relief: Decongestants (Pseudoephedrine)
prevention: Avoid close contact with sick individuals
Avoid touching face with unwashed hands
diseases.note: This information is for suggestions and knowing the disease. Do not use it unless by talking to a professional doctor.

diseases.name: Influenza (The Flu)
diseases.description: A contagious respiratory illness caused by influenza viruses.
diseases.note: This information is for suggestions and knowing the disease. Do not use it unless by talking to a professional doctor.

diseases.name: COVID-19
diseases.description: A respiratory illness caused by the SARS-CoV-2 virus.
diseases.note: This information is for suggestions and knowing the disease. Do not use it unless by talking to a professional doctor.

diseases.name: Strep Throat
diseases.description: A bacterial infection causing inflammation and pain in the throat.
diseases.note: This information is for suggestions and knowing the disease. Do not use it unless by talking to a professional doctor.

diseases.name: Pneumonia
diseases.description: Infection that inflames air sacs in one or both lungs.
diseases.note: This information is for suggestions and knowing the disease. Do not use it unless by talking to a professional doctor.

diseases.name: Bronchitis

diseases.note: This information is for suggestions and knowing the disease. Do not use it unless by talking to a professional doctor.

diseases.name: Sinusitis
diseases.description: Inflammation of the tissue lining the sinuses.
diseases.note: This information is for suggestions and knowing the disease. Do not use it unless by talking to a professional doctor.

diseases.name: Tuberculosis (TB)
diseases.description: A potentially serious infectious disease affecting the lungs.
medicines: Antibiotics (Isoniazid, Rifampin) - long-term treatment under strict medical supervision
diseases.note: This information is for suggestions and knowing the disease. Do not use it unless by talking to a professional doctor.

diseases.name: Mononucleosis (Mono)
diseases.description: Often called the kissing disease, caused by Epstein-Barr virus.
medicines: Corticosteroids for severe swelling - prescription required
diseases.note: This information is for suggestions and knowing the disease. Do not use it unless by talking to a professional doctor.

diseases.name: Urinary Tract Infection (UTI)
diseases.description: Infection in any part of the urinary system.
diseases.note: This information is for suggestions and knowing the disease. Do not use it unless by talking to a professional doctor.

diseases.name: Yeast Infection (Candidiasis)
diseases.description: Fungal infection caused by Candida overgrowth.
medicines: Antifungal creams (Clotrimazole) - some OTC, some prescription
diseases.note: This information is for suggestions and knowing the disease. Do not use it unless by talking to a professional doctor.

diseases.name: Bacterial Vaginosis
diseases.description: An overgrowth of bacteria in the vagina.
diseases.note: This information is for suggestions and knowing the disease. Do not use it unless by talking to a professional doctor.

diseases.name: Hepatitis A
diseases.description: Highly contagious liver infection from HAV.
diseases.note: This information is for suggestions and knowing the disease. Do not use it unless by talking to a professional doctor.

diseases.name: Hepatitis B
diseases.description: Serious liver infection caused by HBV.
diseases.note: This information is for suggestions and knowing the disease. Do not use it unless by talking to a professional doctor.

diseases.name: Hepatitis C
diseases.description: Liver infection caused by HCV, often chronic.
diseases.note: This information is for suggestions and knowing the disease. Do not use it unless by talking to a professional doctor.

diseases.name: HIV/AIDS
diseases.description: Chronic condition caused by human immunodeficiency virus.
medicines: Antiretroviral therapy (ART) - multiple drug combinations - prescription required
diseases.note: This information is for suggestions and knowing the disease. Do not use it unless by talking to a professional doctor.

diseases.name: Chlamydia
diseases.description: Common sexually transmitted bacterial infection.
diseases.note: This information is for suggestions and knowing the disease. Do not use it unless by talking to a professional doctor.

diseases.name: Gonorrhea

diseases.note: This information is for suggestions and knowing the disease. Do not use it unless by talking to a professional doctor.

diseases.name: Herpes Simplex Virus (HSV)
diseases.description: Viral infection causing sores around mouth/genitals.
diseases.note: This information is for suggestions and knowing the disease. Do not use it unless by talking to a professional doctor.

diseases.name: Human Papillomavirus (HPV)
diseases.description: Very common STI that can cause warts and cancer.
medicines: Treatments for warts (imiquimod, podofilox) - prescription often required
home_care: Follow medical advice for abnormal cells
diseases.note: This information is for suggestions and knowing the disease. Do not use it unless by talking to a professional doctor.

diseases.name: Syphilis
diseases.description: Bacterial STI that progresses in stages.
diseases.note: This information is for suggestions and knowing the disease. Do not use it unless by talking to a professional doctor.

diseases.name: Conjunctivitis (Pink Eye)
diseases.description: Inflammation of the conjunctiva.
diseases.note: This information is for suggestions and knowing the disease. Do not use it unless by talking to a professional doctor.

diseases.name: Gastroenteritis (Stomach Flu)
diseases.description: Intestinal infection causing diarrhea/cramps/nausea.
diseases.note: This information is for suggestions and knowing the disease. Do not use it unless by talking to a professional doctor.

diseases.name: Food Poisoning
diseases.description: Illness from consuming contaminated food.
medicines: Antibiotics for specific types - prescription required
diseases.note: This information is for suggestions and knowing the disease. Do not use it unless by talking to a professional doctor.

diseases.name: Norovirus
diseases.description: Highly contagious virus causing vomiting/diarrhea.
medicines: No specific antiviral. Supportive care for symptoms.
prevention: Avoid preparing food for others when sick
diseases.note: This information is for suggestions and knowing the disease. Do not use it unless by talking to a professional doctor.

diseases.name: Appendicitis
diseases.description: Inflammation of the appendix.
symptoms: Sudden pain near navel shifting to lower right abdomen
medicines: Intravenous antibiotics before surgery - prescription/hospital administered
home_care: None. This is a medical emergency requiring immediate care.
diseases.note: This information is for suggestions and knowing the disease. Do not use it unless by talking to a professional doctor.

diseases.name: Cellulitis
diseases.description: Common bacterial skin infection.
diseases.note: This information is for suggestions and knowing the disease. Do not use it unless by talking to a professional doctor.

diseases.name: Athlete's Foot
diseases.description: Fungal infection on the feet.
medicines: Oral antifungals for severe cases - prescription required
diseases.note: This information is for suggestions and knowing the disease. Do not use it unless by talking to a professional doctor.

diseases.name: Ringworm (Tinea Corporis)
diseases.description: Fungal infection causing ring-shaped rash.
diseases.note: This information is for suggestions and knowing the disease. Do not use it unless by talking to a professional doctor.

diseases.name: Impetigo
diseases.description: Highly contagious skin infection common in children.
diseases.note: This information is for suggestions and knowing the disease. Do not use it unless by talking to a professional doctor.

diseases.name: Shingles (Herpes Zoster)
diseases.description: Painful rash caused by reactivation of chickenpox virus.
diseases.note: This information is for suggestions and knowing the disease. Do not use it unless by talking to a professional doctor.

diseases.name: Chickenpox
diseases.description: Highly contagious viral illness causing itchy rash.
diseases.note: This information is for suggestions and knowing the disease. Do not use it unless by talking to a professional doctor.

diseases.name: Measles
diseases.description: Highly contagious viral infection.
diseases.note: This information is for suggestions and knowing the disease. Do not use it unless by talking to a professional doctor.

diseases.name: Mumps
diseases.description: Viral infection affecting salivary glands.
diseases.note: This information is for suggestions and knowing the disease. Do not use it unless by talking to a professional doctor.

diseases.name: Rubella (German Measles)
diseases.description: Contagious viral infection with red rash.
diseases.note: This information is for suggestions and knowing the disease. Do not use it unless by talking to a professional doctor.

diseases.name: Malaria
diseases.description: Mosquito-borne disease caused by a parasite.
medicines: Antimalarial drugs (Chloroquine, Artemisinin-based combination therapy) - prescription required
home_care: Take prescribed drugs exactly as directed
diseases.note: This information is for suggestions and knowing the disease. Do not use it unless by talking to a professional doctor.

diseases.name: Dengue Fever
diseases.description: Mosquito-borne viral infection.
diseases.note: This information is for suggestions and knowing the disease. Do not use it unless by talking to a professional doctor.

diseases.name: Lyme Disease
diseases.description: Tick-borne illness caused by Borrelia bacteria.
diseases.note: This information is for suggestions and knowing the disease. Do not use it unless by talking to a professional doctor.

diseases.name: Tetanus
diseases.description: Serious bacterial disease causing muscle stiffness.
medicines: Muscle relaxants - all require medical care
home_care: None. This is a medical emergency.
diseases.note: This information is for suggestions and knowing the disease. Do not use it unless by talking to a professional doctor.

diseases.name: Whooping Cough (Pertussis)
diseases.description: Highly contagious respiratory tract infection.
diseases.note: This information is for suggestions and knowing the disease. Do not use it unless by talking to a professional doctor.

diseases.name: Meningitis
diseases.description: Inflammation of membranes around brain/spinal cord.
home_care: None. This is a medical emergency requiring immediate care.
diseases.note: This information is for suggestions and knowing the disease. Do not use it unless by talking to a professional doctor.

diseases.name: Hypertension (High Blood Pressure)
diseases.description: Long-term force of blood against artery walls is high.
symptoms: Severe: Headaches, shortness of breath, nosebleeds
medicines: Calcium channel blockers - all prescription required
diseases.note: This information is for suggestions and knowing the disease. Do not use it unless by talking to a professional doctor.

diseases.name: Coronary Artery Disease (CAD)
diseases.description: Plaque buildup in heart's arteries.
diseases.note: This information is for suggestions and knowing the disease. Do not use it unless by talking to a professional doctor.

diseases.name: Heart Failure
diseases.description: Heart doesn't pump blood as well as it should.
prevention: Control conditions leading to HF (CAD, HBP, diabetes)
diseases.note: This information is for suggestions and knowing the disease. Do not use it unless by talking to a professional doctor.

diseases.name: Heart Attack (Myocardial Infarction)
diseases.description: Blockage of blood flow to the heart muscle.
diseases.note: This information is for suggestions and knowing the disease. Do not use it unless by talking to a professional doctor.

diseases.name: Stroke
diseases.description: Blood supply to part of brain interrupted.
home_care: None. This is a medical emergency. Act F.A.S.T. and call ambulance.
diseases.note: This information is for suggestions and knowing the disease. Do not use it unless by talking to a professional doctor.

diseases.name: High Cholesterol (Hyperlipidemia)
diseases.description: High levels of fats (lipids) in the blood.
symptoms: None. It is a silent condition.
diseases.note: This information is for suggestions and knowing the disease. Do not use it unless by talking to a professional doctor.

diseases.name: Type 2 Diabetes
diseases.description: Chronic condition affecting how body processes blood sugar.
diseases.note: This information is for suggestions and knowing the disease. Do not use it unless by talking to a professional doctor.

diseases.name: Type 1 Diabetes
diseases.description: Autoimmune condition where pancreas produces little/no insulin.
symptoms: Same as Type 2, but often more severe and sudden onset
medicines: Insulin (via injection or pump) - prescription required
diseases.note: This information is for suggestions and knowing the disease. Do not use it unless by talking to a professional doctor.

diseases.name: Hypothyroidism
diseases.description: Underactive thyroid gland.
home_care: Take medication consistently on empty stomach
Regular blood tests to monitor levels
diseases.note: This information is for suggestions and knowing the disease. Do not use it unless by talking to a professional doctor.

diseases.name: Hyperthyroidism
diseases.description: Overactive thyroid gland.
diseases.note: This information is for suggestions and knowing the disease. Do not use it unless by talking to a professional doctor.

diseases.name: Asthma
diseases.description: Condition where airways narrow/swell, produce extra mucus.
medicines: Quick-relief (Short-acting beta agonists like Albuterol) - prescription required
diseases.note: This information is for suggestions and knowing the disease. Do not use it unless by talking to a professional doctor.

diseases.name: Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease (COPD)
diseases.description: Chronic inflammatory lung disease causing obstructed airflow.
diseases.note: This information is for suggestions and knowing the disease. Do not use it unless by talking to a professional doctor.

diseases.name: Chronic Kidney Disease (CKD)
diseases.description: Gradual loss of kidney function over time.
diseases.note: This information is for suggestions and knowing the disease. Do not use it unless by talking to a professional doctor.

diseases.name: Kidney Stones
diseases.description: Hard deposits of minerals and salts inside kidneys.
medicines: Pain relievers (NSAIDs) - prescription strength often needed
Alpha blockers to help pass stones - prescription required
diseases.note: This information is for suggestions and knowing the disease. Do not use it unless by talking to a professional doctor.

diseases.name: Gout
diseases.description: Form of arthritis characterized by sudden, severe attacks of pain.
medicines: Medications to block uric acid production (Allopurinol) - prescription required
prevention: Limit high-purine foods (red meat, organ meat)
diseases.note: This information is for suggestions and knowing the disease. Do not use it unless by talking to a professional doctor.

diseases.name: Osteoarthritis
diseases.description: Most common form of arthritis, wearing down of joint cartilage.
diseases.note: This information is for suggestions and knowing the disease. Do not use it unless by talking to a professional doctor.

diseases.name: Rheumatoid Arthritis (RA)
diseases.description: Autoimmune disorder where immune system attacks joints.
diseases.note: This information is for suggestions and knowing the disease. Do not use it unless by talking to a professional doctor.

diseases.name: Osteoporosis
diseases.description: Bones become weak and brittle.
symptoms: Often no symptoms until fracture occurs
diseases.note: This information is for suggestions and knowing the disease. Do not use it unless by talking to a professional doctor.

diseases.name: Fibromyalgia
diseases.description: Disorder characterized by widespread musculoskeletal pain.
diseases.note: This information is for suggestions and knowing the disease. Do not use it unless by talking to a professional doctor.

diseases.name: Chronic Fatigue Syndrome
diseases.description: Complex disorder characterized by extreme fatigue.
symptoms: Severe fatigue not improved by rest
medicines: Symptom-focused: Antidepressants, Sleep aids, Pain relievers - prescription required
diseases.note: This information is for suggestions and knowing the disease. Do not use it unless by talking to a professional doctor.

diseases.name: Epilepsy
diseases.description: Central nervous system disorder causing seizures.
medicines: Anti-seizure medications (Levetiracetam, Lamotrigine, Valproic acid) - prescription required
prevention: No known prevention, but can be managed
diseases.note: This information is for suggestions and knowing the disease. Do not use it unless by talking to a professional doctor.

diseases.name: Alzheimer's Disease
diseases.description: Progressive neurologic disorder causing brain shrinkage/cell death.
diseases.note: This information is for suggestions and knowing the disease. Do not use it unless by talking to a professional doctor.

diseases.name: Parkinson's Disease
diseases.description: Progressive nervous system disorder affecting movement.
diseases.note: This information is for suggestions and knowing the disease. Do not use it unless by talking to a professional doctor.

diseases.name: Multiple Sclerosis (MS)
diseases.description: Disease where immune system eats away protective nerve covering.
medicines: Disease-modifying therapies (Interferon beta, Ocrelizumab) - prescription required
diseases.note: This information is for suggestions and knowing the disease. Do not use it unless by talking to a professional doctor.

diseases.name: Migraines
diseases.description: Recurrent headaches often with sensory disturbances.
medicines: Preventive meds (Beta blockers, Anticonvulsants) - prescription required
home_care: Caffeine in small amounts (can help some)
diseases.note: This information is for suggestions and knowing the disease. Do not use it unless by talking to a professional doctor.

diseases.name: Tension Headaches
diseases.description: Common headache often from muscle contraction.
medicines: Preventive meds if chronic (Tricyclic antidepressants) - prescription required
diseases.note: This information is for suggestions and knowing the disease. Do not use it unless by talking to a professional doctor.

diseases.name: Anxiety Disorders
diseases.description: Excessive nervousness, fear, apprehension, and worry.
diseases.note: This information is for suggestions and knowing the disease. Do not use it unless by talking to a professional doctor.

diseases.name: Depression (Major Depressive Disorder)
diseases.description: Mood disorder causing persistent feeling of sadness/loss of interest.
home_care: Take care of yourself (sleep, diet, exercise)
diseases.note: This information is for suggestions and knowing the disease. Do not use it unless by talking to a professional doctor.

diseases.name: Bipolar Disorder
diseases.description: Disorder associated with mood swings from depressive lows to manic highs.
symptoms: Mania: Euphoria, high energy, reduced need for sleep, recklessness
medicines: Antidepressants - prescription required, managed by psychiatrist
prevention: No known prevention, but treatment prevents episodes
diseases.note: This information is for suggestions and knowing the disease. Do not use it unless by talking to a professional doctor.

diseases.name: Schizophrenia
diseases.description: Severe mental disorder affecting reality interpretation.
diseases.note: This information is for suggestions and knowing the disease. Do not use it unless by talking to a professional doctor.

diseases.name: Autism Spectrum Disorder (ASD)
diseases.description: Developmental disorder impacting communication/behavior.
medicines: No core medication. Meds may be used for co-occurring symptoms (irritability, ADHD) - prescription required
diseases.note: This information is for suggestions and knowing the disease. Do not use it unless by talking to a professional doctor.

diseases.name: Attention-Deficit/Hyperactivity Disorder (ADHD)
diseases.description: Chronic condition including attention difficulty, hyperactivity, impulsivity.
diseases.note: This information is for suggestions and knowing the disease. Do not use it unless by talking to a professional doctor.

diseases.name: Irritable Bowel Syndrome (IBS)
diseases.description: Common disorder affecting large intestine.
diseases.note: This information is for suggestions and knowing the disease. Do not use it unless by talking to a professional doctor.

diseases.name: Crohn's Disease
diseases.description: Type of inflammatory bowel disease (IBD).
diseases.note: This information is for suggestions and knowing the disease. Do not use it unless by talking to a professional doctor.

diseases.name: Ulcerative Colitis
diseases.description: IBD causing inflammation/ulcers in digestive tract.
diseases.note: This information is for suggestions and knowing the disease. Do not use it unless by talking to a professional doctor.

diseases.name: Celiac Disease
diseases.description: Immune reaction to eating gluten.
medicines: No specific medication. Strict gluten-free diet is treatment.
diseases.note: This information is for suggestions and knowing the disease. Do not use it unless by talking to a professional doctor.

diseases.name: GERD (Gastroesophageal Reflux Disease)
diseases.description: Chronic acid reflux.
symptoms: Sensation of a lump in throat
medicines: Proton pump inhibitors (Omeprazole) - some OTC, some prescription
diseases.note: This information is for suggestions and knowing the disease. Do not use it unless by talking to a professional doctor.

diseases.name: Peptic Ulcers
diseases.description: Sores that develop on stomach/small intestine lining.
prevention: Protect against H. pylori (handwashing, safe food)
diseases.note: This information is for suggestions and knowing the disease. Do not use it unless by talking to a professional doctor.

diseases.name: Cirrhosis
diseases.description: Late stage of scarring (fibrosis) of the liver.
medicines: Medications to slow progression (depending on cause)
diseases.note: This information is for suggestions and knowing the disease. Do not use it unless by talking to a professional doctor.

diseases.name: Fatty Liver Disease
diseases.description: Build-up of fat in liver cells.
medicines: No specific medication. Focus on controlling causes.
diseases.note: This information is for suggestions and knowing the disease. Do not use it unless by talking to a professional doctor.

diseases.name: Anemia
diseases.description: Lack of enough healthy red blood cells.
medicines: Medications to increase blood cell production - some prescription required
diseases.note: This information is for suggestions and knowing the disease. Do not use it unless by talking to a professional doctor.

diseases.name: Hemophilia
diseases.description: Disorder where blood doesn't clot normally.
medicines: Clotting factor concentrates (replacement therapy) - prescription required
diseases.note: This information is for suggestions and knowing the disease. Do not use it unless by talking to a professional doctor.

diseases.name: Deep Vein Thrombosis (DVT)
diseases.description: Blood clot forming in a deep vein, usually in the leg.
medicines: Anticoagulants (blood thinners like Warfarin, Rivaroxaban) - prescription required
home_care: Monitor for signs of PE (chest pain)
diseases.note: This information is for suggestions and knowing the disease. Do not use it unless by talking to a professional doctor.

diseases.name: Psoriasis
diseases.description: Skin disease causing red, itchy scaly patches.
symptoms: Red patches covered with silvery scales
prevention: No known prevention, but can reduce flares
diseases.note: This information is for suggestions and knowing the disease. Do not use it unless by talking to a professional doctor.

diseases.name: Eczema (Atopic Dermatitis)
diseases.description: Condition that makes skin red and itchy.
medicines: Oral drugs for severe cases - prescription required
diseases.note: This information is for suggestions and knowing the disease. Do not use it unless by talking to a professional doctor.

diseases.name: Acne Vulgaris
diseases.description: Skin condition when hair follicles clog with oil/dead skin.
diseases.note: This information is for suggestions and knowing the disease. Do not use it unless by talking to a professional doctor.

diseases.name: Rosacea
diseases.description: Common skin condition causing facial redness.
medicines: Isotretinoin for severe cases - prescription required
prevention: Identify/avoid triggers (spicy food, alcohol, temperature extremes)
home_care: Use green-tinted makeup to counter redness
diseases.note: This information is for suggestions and knowing the disease. Do not use it unless by talking to a professional doctor.

diseases.name: Hives (Urticaria)
diseases.description: Skin reaction causing raised, itchy welts.
medicines: Corticosteroids for severe cases - some prescription required
prevention: Avoid known triggers (foods, medications, heat, pressure)
diseases.note: This information is for suggestions and knowing the disease. Do not use it unless by talking to a professional doctor.

diseases.name: Lupus (Systemic Lupus Erythematosus)
diseases.description: Autoimmune disease where body attacks own tissues.
diseases.note: This information is for suggestions and knowing the disease. Do not use it unless by talking to a professional doctor.

diseases.name: Sleep Apnea
diseases.description: Potentially serious sleep disorder where breathing stops/starts.
medicines: No specific medication. Treatment is devices/therapy.
diseases.note: This information is for suggestions and knowing the disease. Do not use it unless by talking to a professional doctor.

diseases.name: Insomnia
diseases.description: Persistent problems falling/staying asleep.
diseases.note: This information is for suggestions and knowing the disease. Do not use it unless by talking to a professional doctor.

diseases.name: Obesity
diseases.description: Complex disorder involving excessive body fat.
medicines: Weight-loss medications (Orlistat, Phentermine-topiramate, Liraglutide) - prescription required
diseases.note: This information is for suggestions and knowing the disease. Do not use it unless by talking to a professional doctor.

diseases.name: Lung Cancer
diseases.description: Cancer that begins in the lungs.
medicines: Immunotherapy - all require specialized oncologic care
diseases.note: This information is for suggestions and knowing the disease. Do not use it unless by talking to a professional doctor.

diseases.name: Breast Cancer
diseases.description: Cancer that forms in breast cells.
medicines: Targeted therapy - all require specialized oncologic care
diseases.note: This information is for suggestions and knowing the disease. Do not use it unless by talking to a professional doctor.

diseases.name: Prostate Cancer
diseases.description: Cancer in the prostate gland in men.
medicines: Chemotherapy - all require specialized oncologic care
diseases.note: This information is for suggestions and knowing the disease. Do not use it unless by talking to a professional doctor.

diseases.name: Colorectal Cancer
diseases.description: Cancer of the colon or rectum.
medicines: Immunotherapy - all require specialized oncologic care
diseases.note: This information is for suggestions and knowing the disease. Do not use it unless by talking to a professional doctor.

diseases.name: Skin Cancer
diseases.description: Abnormal growth of skin cells, often on sun-exposed skin.
diseases.note: This information is for suggestions and knowing the disease. Do not use it unless by talking to a professional doctor.

diseases.name: Benign Prostatic Hyperplasia (BPH)
diseases.description: Enlarged prostate gland.
diseases.note: This information is for suggestions and knowing the disease. Do not use it unless by talking to a professional doctor.

diseases.name: Erectile Dysfunction (ED)
diseases.description: Inability to get/maintain an erection firm for sex.
medicines: Phosphodiesterase type 5 inhibitors (Sildenafil, Tadalafil) - prescription required
diseases.note: This information is for suggestions and knowing the disease. Do not use it unless by talking to a professional doctor.

diseases.name: Polycystic Ovary Syndrome (PCOS)
diseases.description: Hormonal disorder common in women of reproductive age.
medicines: Birth control pills to regulate cycles
prevention: No known prevention, but early diagnosis/treatment helps
diseases.note: This information is for suggestions and knowing the disease. Do not use it unless by talking to a professional doctor.

diseases.name: Endometriosis
diseases.description: Tissue similar to uterine lining grows outside uterus.
medicines: Hormone therapy (birth control, Gn-RH agonists) - prescription required
diseases.note: This information is for suggestions and knowing the disease. Do not use it unless by talking to a professional doctor.

diseases.name: Uterine Fibroids
diseases.description: Noncancerous growths in the uterus.
diseases.note: This information is for suggestions and knowing the disease. Do not use it unless by talking to a professional doctor.

diseases.name: Menopause
diseases.description: Time marking end of menstrual cycles.
diseases.note: This information is for suggestions and knowing the disease. Do not use it unless by talking to a professional doctor.

diseases.name: Cataracts
diseases.description: Clouding of the eye's natural lens.
medicines: No medication. Surgery is the only effective treatment.
diseases.note: This information is for suggestions and knowing the disease. Do not use it unless by talking to a professional doctor.

diseases.name: Glaucoma
diseases.description: Group of eye conditions damaging optic nerve.
diseases.note: This information is for suggestions and knowing the disease. Do not use it unless by talking to a professional doctor.

diseases.name: Macular Degeneration
diseases.description: Eye disease blurring central vision.
medicines: No cure. For wet AMD: Anti-VEGF injections (Ranibizumab, Aflibercept) - prescription required
diseases.note: This information is for suggestions and knowing the disease. Do not use it unless by talking to a professional doctor.

diseases.name: Tinnitus
diseases.description: Perception of noise/ringing in the ears.
medicines: No specific drug. Treatment targets underlying cause or reduces perception.
diseases.note: This information is for suggestions and knowing the disease. Do not use it unless by talking to a professional doctor.

diseases.name: Hearing Loss
diseases.description: Partial or total inability to hear.
medicines: Depends on cause. May include antibiotics for infection, steroids for inflammation - prescription required
diseases.note: This information is for suggestions and knowing the disease. Do not use it unless by talking to a professional doctor.
